title: Merchandise Purchases Return Fee Tariff and Accepted Return Methods
content:
The fees below are deducted from the refund of a returned **Merchandise Purchases** unit, and the methods are the only ways a unit of each class may be sent back.

## Tariff 1 — Restocking fee

| Merchandise class | Restocking fee (percent of the net paid amount of the returned item) | Returns that draw it |
|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | 0 | none |
| Beauty & Fragrance | 0 | none |
| Home & Kitchen | 0 | none |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | 15 | opened items only |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | 0 | none |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | 0 | none |
| Furniture & Mattresses | 15 | all items |

## Tariff 2 — Return methods and their fees

| Merchandise class | Return methods accepted | Prepaid mail-return label fee | Scheduled carrier pickup fee | Label or pickup valid for (calendar days after the return is authorized) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | in store; mail with a prepaid label; mail with own postage | $9.95 | not offered | 30 |
| Beauty & Fragrance | in store; mail with a prepaid label; mail with own postage | $9.95 | not offered | 30 |
| Home & Kitchen | in store; mail with a prepaid label; mail with own postage | $9.95 | not offered | 30 |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | in store; mail with a prepaid label | $9.95 | not offered | 30 |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | in store; mail with a prepaid label | $0.00 | not offered | 14 |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | in store | not offered | not offered | 14 |
| Furniture & Mattresses | carrier pickup | not offered | $99.00 | 21 |

## Tariff 3 — Fee waivers, gifts with purchase and delivery fees

- **Fee-waiver reasons (every class):** defective, damaged in transit, not as described. For these return reasons no restocking fee and no return label fee is ever charged.
- **Gift with purchase kept by the customer:** only the Beauty & Fragrance class deducts it, at $18.00. For every other class no deduction is made and no value is set.
- **Home delivery fee on a return:** in every class the home delivery fee paid for the item is not refunded when the item is returned for a reason other than a fee-waiver reason.

### Hypothetical worked figures (illustration only)

- An opened Electronics & Small Appliances unit with a net paid amount of $200.00 returned as changed mind: the restocking fee is 15 percent of that amount, $30.00. The same unit unopened draws no restocking fee, because the class charges it on opened items only.
- A Furniture & Mattresses unit draws the 15 percent fee whether opened or not, and its only return method is a carrier pickup at $99.00.
- A Fine Jewelry & Watches unit mailed back with a prepaid label carries a label fee of $0.00.
